prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested onboarding changes.
Deferring sign-in after adoption showed no clear effect.
Adding a desktop quick shortcut guide showed no clear effect.
Prompting desktop spawn notifications showed no clear effect.
Simplifying the path choice layout showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -8.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Preview Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live animated previews and interactive personality reaction tags for each pet. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (60.9% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s); interactive previews help users make faster, more confident pet choices.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Warning Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing into an existing account syncs and restores saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Selection Assistant Flow: Introduce a multi-step photo checklist with real-time photo quality feedback when creating a custom pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to adoption step drop-off.)
3: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress and Tip Carousel: Enhance the waiting screen with a live step-by-step progress indicator and rotating tips on desktop pet behaviors. (why: Home waiting screen takes mean 2336s, and support logs show users are confused about how pets spawn on desktop (3 emails).)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Clear Expectation Copy: Update choose_path headline and body text to clearly contrast instant pre-made pets versus custom AI pet creation. (why: choose_path drop-off is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s due to decision hesitation.)
5: [choose_path, reorder] Narrative-First Onboarding Flow Reorder: Reorder onboarding to place the story screen right before choose_path to build emotional connection before decision making. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%; establishing emotional attachment upfront improves progression across all steps.)
